During this, it becomes a [[Flying]] enemy. |ability1_cooldown = 8-12 }} ==Description== The '''Voidling''' is a fast enemy that appears in both [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode. It has rather high health though lower than the [[Blighted]], but it is twice as fast as it. It has one ability where on maps with more than one path, it will jump from one path to another around every 8 to 12 seconds. During this, it becomes a [[Flying]] enemy. As no maps in either mode it appears in have more than one path, this ability cannot be seen in normal gameplay. ==Logbook Description== "''Voidlings are the army’s standard issue. They are an Odd crammed into a set of armor and set loose into the world. When possible, they will throw themselves across the field and continue their path towards the enemy without any regard to their safety. They simply go where they are told and will do everything they can to get there.''" ==Appearance== The '''Voidling''' has purple skin and neon pink eyes. One of its arms is visibly shorter than the other. It wears grey armor on its feet, shoulders neck and waist, strapped to it with brown clothing. It also has multiple neon pink crystals growing on its body. ==Strategy== *DPS towers such as the [[Crook Boss]], [[Accelerator]], [[Enforcer]], and [[Engineer]] can be helpful at taking down the '''Voidling'''. **Support towers such as the [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can further support your towers to defeating it quicker. *As the '''Voidling''' is quite fast, slowing towers such as the [[Freezer]], [[Electroshocker]], and [[Tesla]] can be used to slow and stun it, mitigating its speed. **Do be aware that due to its normally large size, it can only be slowed down for a short amount of time compared to smaller enemies. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|{{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Hardcore Rework Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Voidling''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} VoidlingIconIG.png|'''Voidling''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Voidling's''' ability to jump between paths goes unused in both [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] modes as neither mode actually contains maps with more than one path. **This means it can only actually be seen in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **Despite this being practically unused, its logbook description still mentions this ability. **This technically makes the '''Voidling''' the first non-boss enemy able to switch lanes, and also the second evergreen enemy to be able to do so (the first being [[Frost Spirit]]). *The '''Voidling''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Voidling''' added. {{Hardcore|[[Cursed Skeleton]]|Wave 20|Voidling|Wave 21|[[Void Reaper]]|Wave 22}} {{Voidcore|[[Mandrake]]|Wave 19|Voidling|Wave 20|[[Elite Phantom]]|Wave 22}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
